crop_resize.plain_crop_fit: A 512x256 crop fits inside 960x540 directly; no resize needed for an upstream-style (SceneFlowLoader: random 256x512 crop, disparity raw) presentation of FT3D
crop_resize.upstream_presentation: No resampling, no disparity scaling: random 256x512 crop of image+PFM, ToTensor+ImageNet-normalize images, PFM raw pixels, mask disp<160 (dataloader/SceneFlowLoader.py:51-67; sceneflow-pretrain.py:20-21,96-103)
crop_resize.p2a_scale_aug_geometry_on_ft3d: Applicable UNCHANGED: s~logUniform(0.7,1.7) -> w=round(512/s) in [301,731], h=round(256/s) in [151,366]; every (h,w) window fits in 960x540 (as it fits in KITTI 1232x368). Crop -> BILINEAR images + NEAREST disparity resize to 256x512 -> disparity[d>0] *= sx with sx=512/w in [0.700,1.701] (phase2/scripts/train_p2a_scale_coverage.py:79-114)
crop_resize.resampling_changes_disparity: YES: horizontal resize by sx multiplies true disparity by sx (the P2A recipe does exactly this, line 101); vertical-only scaling leaves disparity unchanged; NEAREST avoids inventing GT values at edges (0 stays 0 = invalid)
crop_resize.effective_distribution_under_p2a_scale_a: NOT MEASURABLE WITH CURRENT ARTIFACTS: requires Monte-Carlo emulation of the exact P2A recipe over FT3D pixels (crop+NEAREST+sx+mask), i.e. a new training-path-equivalent data pipeline this audit was prohibited from writing. Directional only: s>1 (sx>1) shifts mass right (more 64-128 px supervision, some pushed past 184 and masked); s<1 shifts mass left. The future ARM-P recipe (upstream-style vs P2A-scale-aug vs other) is itself UNDECIDED - a FINDING, not a failure.
